title: Theme parks and springs in Orlando
summary: Seven days of theme parks and the space coast, springs and manatees, and the quieter, tree-lined side of Orlando and Winter Park.
author: friends of Placemoir

places.name: Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa
places.address: 4401 Floridian Way, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
places.notes: Disney's grandest hotel, one monorail stop from the Magic Kingdom. Watch the fireworks from the beach.

places.name: Disney's Pop Century Resort
places.address: 1050 Century Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
places.notes: The budget Disney pick, with the Skyliner gondola to EPCOT and Hollywood Studios.

places.name: Loews Royal Pacific Resort
places.notes: A South Seas-style hotel with a short boat ride to Universal. A stay includes Universal Express passes.

places.name: The Alfond Inn
places.address: 300 E New England Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
places.notes: A calm hotel full of contemporary art, a walk from Park Avenue. A good base away from the parks.

places.name: Victoria & Albert's
places.address: 4401 Floridian Way, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
places.notes: Disney's tasting-menu splurge, in the Grand Floridian. Dress up and book months ahead.

places.name: Sanaa
places.notes: African-Indian cooking with giraffes and zebras outside the window. Order the bread service.

places.name: Raglan Road Irish Pub
places.address: 1640 E Buena Vista Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
places.notes: Irish food, live music and dancers every night at Disney Springs.

places.name: The Boathouse
places.address: 1620 E Buena Vista Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
places.notes: Steaks and seafood on the water, with vintage amphicar rides out front.

places.name: The Ravenous Pig
places.address: 565 W Fairbanks Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
places.notes: Winter Park's gastropub, with house-made charcuterie and its own beer.

places.name: Prato
places.address: 124 N Park Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
places.notes: Wood-fired pizza and pasta on Park Avenue. Sit on the sidewalk.

places.name: Hawkers Asian Street Food
places.notes: Small plates from across Asia. The roti canai and the curry laksa are favorites.

places.name: Pho 88
places.notes: Huge bowls of pho in Orlando's Vietnamese district, cheap and quick.

places.name: Se7en Bites
places.notes: A Southern bake shop with giant breakfasts and slices of pie.

places.name: Black Bean Deli
places.notes: Cuban sandwiches and plantains in a converted gas station.

places.name: Kres Chophouse
places.notes: A dark, handsome downtown steakhouse in a 1930s dime store.

places.name: East End Market
places.notes: A small market hall with good coffee at Lineage and ramen at Domu.

places.name: Dandelion Communitea Café
places.notes: A vegetarian café in an old house, with a porch and a long tea list.

places.name: Wally's Mills Ave Liquors
places.notes: A 1950s dive bar with vintage pin-up wallpaper and cheap, strong drinks.

places.name: Magic Kingdom Park
places.address: 1180 Seven Seas Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
places.notes: Rope drop for the big rides, a break at midday, then back for the fireworks.

places.name: EPCOT
places.notes: Eat your way around the World Showcase lake, one country at a time.

places.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom Theme Park
places.notes: Do the safari early, while the animals are awake, and Pandora at night.

places.name: Universal Studios Florida
places.notes: Ride the Hogwarts Express over to Islands of Adventure with a park-to-park ticket.

places.name: Universal Islands of Adventure
places.notes: Hogsmeade, Hagrid's coaster and the VelociCoaster. Go early for Hagrid's.

places.name: Universal Epic Universe
places.notes: Universal's newest park, with worlds for Nintendo, dragons and Harry Potter's Ministry of Magic.

places.name: Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex
places.address: Space Commerce Way, Merritt Island, FL 32953
places.notes: An hour east. Stand under a Saturn V and walk past Space Shuttle Atlantis. Check the launch schedule.

places.name: Charles Hosmer Morse Museum of American Art
places.address: 445 N Park Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
places.notes: The world's largest Tiffany collection, including a whole chapel. Free on Friday evenings in winter.

places.name: Orlando Museum of Art
places.notes: A compact art museum in Loch Haven Park, next to the science center.

places.name: Orlando Science Center
places.notes: Four floors of hands-on science and a giant dome theater. Good with kids on a park-off day.

places.name: Scenic Boat Tour
places.address: 312 E Morse Blvd, Winter Park, FL 32789
places.notes: An hour on pontoon boats through Winter Park's lakes and narrow canals, past lakeside mansions.

places.name: Gatorland
places.address: 14501 S Orange Blossom Trl, Orlando, FL 32837
places.notes: Old Florida at its most fun: thousands of alligators, a zip line and a gator-wrestling show.

places.name: Disney Springs
places.address: 1486 Buena Vista Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
places.notes: Disney's free shopping and dining district. Good on an evening off from the parks.

places.name: Lake Eola Park
places.notes: A loop around the lake and its fountain, with swans and swan boats. Sunday has a farmers market.

places.name: Harry P. Leu Gardens
places.notes: Fifty acres of camellias, roses and huge oaks draped in Spanish moss.

places.name: Kraft Azalea Garden
places.notes: Cypress trees and a lakeside exedra. Quiet, and lovely at sunset.

places.name: Wekiwa Springs State Park
places.notes: A cold, clear spring for swimming, and a river to paddle. Arrive early, as it fills up.

places.name: Blue Spring State Park
places.address: 2100 W French Ave, Orange City, FL 32763
places.notes: Hundreds of manatees shelter in the spring run from November to March.

places.name: Bok Tower Gardens
places.notes: A singing carillon tower in hilltop gardens an hour south. Time your visit for a recital.
